d: Watch the amphibious capabilities of the Battle Tanks and Infantry Combat Vehicles of the Indian Army, transforming them into a mobile strike force. These formidable machines are unstoppable, even when faced with water obstacles. Witness how tonnes of steel hit the water with unstoppable force and, in the case of the Sarath Infantry Combat Vehicle, float effortlessly. The Indian Army's innovative vehicles redefine the battlefield, taking the terrain out of the equation.
